name: vLLM#55131: Batch-invariant matmul not actually batch-invariant, TF32 precision loss
notes: Two bugs: (1) batch-invariant matmul returns different results for row subset vs full batch when K is power of 2 (512/1024/2048/4096). (2) fp32 path silently degrades to TF32 precision (tl.dot defaults to tf32). Affects precision-sensitive modules like DeepSeek Sparse Attention indexer. Fix: input_precision='ieee'.
